title: Pinned Jordan Decomposition of Characters and Depth-Zero Hecke Algebras
summary: We construct a pinned canonical Jordan decomposition of characters for finite reductive groups in cases where the relevant dual centralizers may be disconnected. For a connected reductive group \(G\) over a finite field, with a fixed pinning, and for a semisimple element \(s\in G^*\), we construct a canonical bijection between the Lusztig series \(\mathcal E(G,s)\) and the unipotent characters of \(C_{G^*}(s)^{F^*}\).
